req.script:
# X08 boot 1: format the blank data disk APFS, then look at it. Throwaway.
# The data disk is found by what it is, not by its number: the VirtIO disk
# with no partition scheme (IOContent None) that is not the boot disk.
set -u
dev=""
for d in $(diskutil list -plist physical | plutil -extract WholeDisks raw -o - - 2>/dev/null; true); do :; done
for d in disk0 disk1 disk2 disk3; do
  c=$(diskutil info $d 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Content \(IOContent\)/{gsub(/^ +/,"",$2);print $2}')
  m=$(diskutil info $d 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Media Name/{gsub(/^ +/,"",$2);print $2}')
  if [ "$c" = "None" ] && [ "$m" = "Apple Inc. VirtIO Block Media" ]; then dev=$d; fi
done
echo "data disk: $dev"
[ -n "$dev" ] || exit 1
t0=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
diskutil eraseDisk APFS WBData GPT $dev
t1=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
echo "TIME format $(echo "$t1 - $t0" | bc) s"
diskutil list $dev
diskutil apfs list
vol=$(diskutil info WBData | awk -F: '/Device Identifier/{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}')
echo "volume: $vol"
diskutil info $vol
mount | grep WBData
ls -la@e /Volumes/WBData
true

req.script:
# X08: what wb-guestd would do at start. Find the data volume by its name,
# move it from wherever Disk Arbitration put it to the fixed mount point,
# with nobrowse, and with nosuid and nodev unless SUID=1. Throwaway.
set -u
mp=/Volumes/wbhomes
t0=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
vol=$(diskutil info WBData 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '/Device Identifier/{gsub(/ /,"",$2);print $2}')
echo "volume: ${vol:-none}"
[ -n "$vol" ] || exit 1
echo "before:"; mount | grep "^/dev/$vol " || echo "  not mounted"
diskutil unmount "$vol" >/dev/null 2>&1
mkdir -p $mp
opts=nobrowse,nosuid,nodev
[ "${SUID:-0}" = 1 ] && opts=nobrowse
diskutil mount -mountOptions "$opts" -mountPoint $mp "$vol"
diskutil enableOwnership $mp
t1=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
echo "TIME mount $(echo "$t1 - $t0" | bc) s"
echo "after:"; mount | grep "^/dev/$vol "
diskutil info "$vol" | grep -E 'Owners|Mount Point'
ls -la $mp

# X08: the host state wb-hostd would keep per project user, used to create
# the users on boot 1 and recreate them on the fresh system disk g2.
# name uid gid user-GeneratedUID group-GeneratedUID
USERS="
wbp1 601 601 CBBC08A1-0DB9-4290-B899-F55CD77080A2 8A30754A-4E5A-469E-B14E-F9182656F981
wbp2 602 602 63095303-1145-4845-8BFD-B9B31627347C 196069B6-2BDC-4677-9AAB-A1A6E436823E
"
HOMES=/Volumes/wbhomes
# X08: create the project users from host state ($USERS, $HOMES, prepended
# by the host). Each gets its own group, a fixed UID, GID and GeneratedUID,
# no password, no admin, hidden, and a home on the data volume. An existing
# home is kept as it is (the recreation case). Throwaway.
set -u
t0=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
chown root:wheel $HOMES
chmod 755 $HOMES
echo "$USERS" | while read -r n uid gid ugu ggu; do
  [ -n "$n" ] || continue
  dscl . -create /Groups/$n
  dscl . -create /Groups/$n PrimaryGroupID $gid
  dscl . -create /Groups/$n GeneratedUID $ggu
  dscl . -create /Groups/$n RealName "x08 $n"
  dscl . -create /Groups/$n Password '*'
  dscl . -create /Users/$n
  dscl . -create /Users/$n UniqueID $uid
  dscl . -create /Users/$n PrimaryGroupID $gid
  dscl . -create /Users/$n GeneratedUID $ugu
  dscl . -create /Users/$n NFSHomeDirectory $HOMES/$n
  dscl . -create /Users/$n UserShell /bin/zsh
  dscl . -create /Users/$n RealName "x08 $n"
  dscl . -create /Users/$n Password '*'
  dscl . -create /Users/$n IsHidden 1
  dscl . -append /Groups/$n GroupMembership $n
  if [ -d $HOMES/$n ]; then
    echo "$n: home exists, kept"
  else
    createhomedir -c -u $n 2>&1 | tail -1
    chmod 700 $HOMES/$n
  fi
done
t1=$(perl -MTime::HiRes=time -e 'printf "%.3f", time')
echo "TIME users $(echo "$t1 - $t0" | bc) s"
echo "$USERS" | while read -r n uid gid ugu ggu; do
  [ -n "$n" ] || continue
  id $n
  dscl . -read /Users/$n UniqueID PrimaryGroupID GeneratedUID NFSHomeDirectory
  dscl . -read /Groups/$n PrimaryGroupID GeneratedUID
  dsmemberutil getuuid -U $n
  dsmemberutil checkmembership -U $n -G admin
  dsmemberutil checkmembership -U $n -G staff
done
ls -lane $HOMES

req.script:
# X08 boot 1: before the reboot of g1, put an fstab entry for the data
# volume by label, so Disk Arbitration mounts it at boot with nosuid and
# nodev at the users' home path. An image could carry this line, because
# the label is the same in every VM, while the volume UUID is not. Throwaway.
set -u
echo 'LABEL=WBData /Volumes/wbhomes apfs rw,nobrowse,nosuid,nodev' > /etc/fstab
chmod 644 /etc/fstab
cat /etc/fstab
sync
